commit.message:
fix(derived_code_mappings): Prevent checking the rate limiting from aborting (#45088)

Checking an org's rate limit is the first step before fetching all trees for each repo. Unfortunately, if Github returns a 401 we will not fetch any trees. This fixes it.

Fixes [SENTRY-YKF](https://sentry.sentry.io/issues/3915010727), however, a new issue with more logging will be created. This may also improve [The tree is empty. Investigate](https://sentry.sentry.io/issues/3915004865).
